question.text: Unsystematic risk is MOSTLY mitigated by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 42 and 148 state that sector- and company-specific (unsystematic) risks can be diversified away by holding securities from other sectors. The Trap: Leverage, higher fees, and shorter holding periods do not reduce firm-specific risk. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 42 and 148.
